info.title: TDEI Management API
info.description: Management API, describes admin & user activities in the TDEI system.

post.summary: Authenticates the user to the TDEI system
post.description: Authenticates the user to the TDEI system.  Returns access token.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the access token object.

post.summary: Authenticates the user to the TDEI system with referral code
post.description: Authenticates the user to the TDEI system with referral code.  Returns token and promo details.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the access token object.

401.description: User not found or invalid credentials.

200.description: Returns true if referral code applied successfully.

410.description: Referral code is expired or inactive.

post.summary: Applies the referral code to the user
post.description: Applies the referral code to the user.

200.description: Successful response - Returns true if referral code applied successfully.

401.description: User not found or invalid credentials.

410.description: Referral code is expired or inactive.

200.description: Returns the user profile details.

post.description: Refresh the user token. Optionally provide a client_id header.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Optional client id. When omitted, client_id is not forwarded to the auth service.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the access token object.
Successful response - Returns the list of roles.

get.summary: Gets the user associated project groups with roles.
get.description: Gets the user associated project groups with roles.Restricted to logged in user project groups and roles.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: User id for which project groups to be fetched

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort by project group name (default) ascending or created_at descending.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the user project groups with roles.

post.summary: Registers the user to the TDEI system
post.description: Registers the user to the TDEI system.  Returns new User object.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the newly created object.

get.summary: Gets the Services in the TDEI system
get.description: Gets the Services in the TDEI system .

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: A bounding box which specifies the area to be searched. A bounding box is specified by a string providing the lat/lon coordinates of the corners of the bounding box. Coordinate should be specified as west, south, east, north.

200.description: Returns the list of Service.

401.description: Unauthenticated request. Check your access token or API-Key.

404.description: tdei_project_group_id or tdei_service_id doesn't exist in the system.

post.summary: Creates a Service in the TDEI system
post.description: Creates a Service in the TDEI system.Returns the id for the newly created flex service.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the id for the newly created flex service.

put.summary: Updates a Service in the TDEI system
put.description: Updates a Service in the TDEI system.

200.description: Service update successful.

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: Service Id of the service to be Activated/Deactivated.

200.description: Successful.

post.summary: Associates a user with the project group and permissions in the TDEI system
post.description: Associates a user with the project group and permissions in the TDEI system. Returns the boolean flag true. Empty permissions array will remove a user from Project Group.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the boolean flag true.
Successful response - Returns the boolean flag true.

get.description: Admin-only. Lists the roles defined for one client in the tdei realm. clientId is the Keycloak client id.

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: Keycloak client id in the tdei realm.

200.description: Successful response.

get.summary: Gets a user's roles for an application
get.description: Returns the roles assigned to one user for one Keycloak client. The caller supplies the client id. A user with no roles for that client returns an empty list. Requires an authenticated user, a service secret, or an API key.

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: Keycloak client id in the tdei realm.

200.description: Successful response.

400.description: userId is not a 36 character user id.

post.description: Admin-only. Adds the listed roles for this client in the tdei realm without changing any other roles. The user is the realm user returned by GET /api/v1/users. Adding a role the user already has succeeds without change. Only roles defined for this client are accepted.

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: Keycloak client id in the tdei realm.

200.description: Successful response.

400.description: Invalid request, or a role that is not defined for this application.

delete.description: Admin-only. Removes only the listed roles for this client in the tdei realm. Removing a role the user does not have succeeds without change.

parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: Keycloak client id in the tdei realm.

200.description: Successful response.

400.description: Invalid request, or a role that is not defined for this application.

get.summary: Gets the project groups in the TDEI system
get.description: Gets the project groups in the TDEI system.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: A bounding box which specifies the area to be searched. A bounding box is specified by a string providing the lat/lon coordinates of the corners of the bounding box. Coordinate should be specified as west, south, east, north.

parameters.name: data_viewer_allowed
parameters.description: Data viewer allowed: Filters project groups based on whether data viewer access is allowed. Uses a boolean value.

200.description: Returns the list of project groups.

401.description: Unauthenticated request. Check your access token or API-key.

404.description: tdei_project_group_id doesn't exist in the system.

post.summary: Creates an project group in the TDEI system
post.description: Creates an project group in the TDEI system.  Returns the id for the newly created project group.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the id for the newly created project group.

put.summary: Updates an project group in the TDEI system
put.description: Updates an project group in the TDEI system.  Returns success if updated.

200.description: Project group update successful.

get.summary: Gets the project group users in the TDEI system
get.description: Gets the project group users in the TDEI system.

parameters.name: projectGroupId
parameters.description: Project group id for which users to be fetched

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: Search by first_name, last_name or username.

200.description: Returns the list of project group users.

parameters.name: projectGroupId
parameters.description: projectGroupId of the project group to be Activated/Deactivated.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Boolean flag to Activate/Deactivate project group.

200.description: Successful.

post.summary: Updates the project group data viewer preferences
post.description: Updates the project group data viewer preferences.

parameters.name: projectGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the project group to update.

200.description: Project group data viewer preferences updated successfully.

post.description: Resets the user credential.  Returns the boolean flag if the password is reset successfully.

200.description: Successful response - Returns the boolean flag if the password is reset successfully.

403.description: Not authorized to reset the password

get.description: Admin-only search of TDEI users. Supports prefix search on first name, last name, and username. Returns username and application roles. Does not return email, phone, or API key.

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: Prefix search against first name, last name, or username.

200.description: Returns the matching TDEI users.

get.summary: Downloads the tdei user details in CSV format
get.description: Downloads the tdei user details in CSV format.

200.description: Returns the tdei user details in CSV format.

get.summary: Lists referral or invite codes for a project group
get.description: Returns a paginated list of referral/promo codes for the specified project group.

parameters.name: projectGroupId
parameters.description: Project group id whose referral codes should be retrieved

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by referral code type. 1 = always available, 2 = limited time.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter by referral code name (partial match).

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Filter by referral code value (partial match).

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Total records to fetch per page.

200.description: Returns a paginated list of referral codes.

post.summary: Creates a referral or invite code
post.description: Creates a new referral/promo code for the specified project group.

parameters.name: projectGroupId
parameters.description: Project group id for which the referral code is being created

200.description: Referral code created successfully.

put.summary: Updates an existing referral or invite code
put.description: Updates an existing referral/promo code for the specified project group.

parameters.name: projectGroupId
parameters.description: Project group id that owns the referral code

parameters.name: code_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the referral code

200.description: Referral code updated successfully.

delete.summary: Deletes (soft deletes) a referral or invite code
delete.description: Marks the specified referral/promo code as inactive.

parameters.name: projectGroupId
parameters.description: Project group id that owns the referral code

parameters.name: code_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the referral code

200.description: Referral code deleted successfully.
